title: The Altar Split at Bethel
reflectionText: A man of God cried against the altar at Bethel. When Jeroboam put out his hand, saying, “Seize him!” his hand dried up, and the altar was split apart. Offered a reward, he would not eat bread nor drink water there, and went another way. How do you answer when a reward would turn you aside?
editorialNotes: Packet 031 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling remains within 1 Kings 13:1-10, keeps the man of God unnamed as in the anchor, keeps WEB Bethel and KJV Beth-el in their own lanes, and ends at verse 10 before the old prophet of verse 11, dovetailing with 3002 (1 Kings 13:11-32).
